title: Philidor's Legacy
setup: The king on h8 is sealed in by its own pawns, and your knight on h6 already covers g8.
hint: Every flight square is gone except one, and it is empty. How do you get a black piece to stand there?
explanation:
## The Idea

This is the **smothered mate**. {{Qg8+}} offers the queen so that Black must block its own escape: {{Rxg8}} is forced, since the knight guards g8. {{Nf7#}} then mates a king with nowhere to go.
